subject: Oceanography
title: Solutions to Ocean Plastic
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Solutions to Ocean Plastic.

hook.text: A UN treaty to end plastic pollution is being negotiated—the first global agreement targeting the plastic lifecycle.

buildup.text: River interception systems catch plastic before it reaches the ocean—the top 1,000 rivers contribute 80% of the flow.

discovery.text: Extended producer responsibility (EPR) makes companies pay for the waste their packaging creates.

twist.text: Cleanup is necessary but insufficient—8 million tons enter the ocean yearly while we remove thousands.

climax.text: The real solution is upstream—reduce production, redesign packaging, and build circular economies.

punchline.text: We can't clean the ocean faster than we pollute it—the tap must close.

quiz.question: Why is ocean cleanup alone insufficient?
options: Plastic enters faster than we can remove it
There isn't enough plastic to matter
